Item 1. Business

We operate retail stores across the country and sell consumer goods to millions of customers every year.

Our cloud segment builds data centers that host AI clusters for enterprise customers.

We design custom accelerators and GPUs for training large language models in our data centers.

We also use AI to improve delivery routes and forecast inventory levels.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Competitors using AI may disrupt our advertising business and reduce demand for our services.

We rely on AI systems that could produce inaccurate outputs and harm our reputation with customers.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Capital expenditures increased primarily due to investments in AI infrastructure and data centers.

Retail revenue grew modestly as consumer demand remained stable during the year.
